title: Coop Kikis
description: Cooperation New Orleans's informal in-person hangout, listed on its Get Involved page as one of the ways to talk with the organization: Wednesdays at lunchtime at Pagoda Cafe, a worker-owned cafe in the 7th Ward (1430 N. Dorgenois St.) that is itself part of the group's co-op ecosystem. No registration or cost is mentioned. The page asks people to check the group's Instagram (@coopneworleans) for updates or changes before going.

recurrence.schedule: Wednesdays, 12:00-1:30pm CT, at Pagoda Cafe. Check @coopneworleans on Instagram for changes.
